name: ACLU Foundation
mission: The American Civil Liberties Union (ACLU) Foundation is the arm of the ACLU that conducts litigation and communication efforts. The Foundation provides legal representation in cases involving issues of civil liberties and constitutional rights, ranging from administrative hearings to trials and appeals. In addition, the Foundation educates the public as to civil liberties and constitutional rights by disseminating literature and other publications. The ACLU Foundation preserves and promotes civil rights and liberties as guaranteed by the United States Constitution.

strengths_deep_dive: The ACLU Foundation's strength lies in its institutional maturity and massive scale of influence. Having been <cite id="11">founded in 1920</cite>, it has a 106-year track record of constitutional defense. Its financial health is bolstered by <cite id="12">total assets of $828,604,389</cite>, allowing it to take on long-term, expensive Supreme Court litigation such as <cite id="13">Case No. 01-332</cite>. Furthermore, its grantmaking capacity is significant, distributing <cite id="14">$68,813,122 in domestic grants</cite> to 187 recipients, including local affiliates like the <cite id="15">ACLU Foundation of Texas</cite>.
rich_narrative.summary: founded in 1920, the American Civil Liberties Union (ACLU) Foundation operates as a premier legal advocacy organization dedicated to <cite id="1">defending and preserving individual rights</cite> guaranteed by the Constitution. In FY2025, the organization reported <cite id="2">total revenue of $185,146,988</cite>, representing an <cite id="4">8% decline from the previous year</cite>. Despite this revenue dip, the foundation maintains a <cite id="3">perfect 100/100 overall score from Charity Navigator</cite>, reflecting top-tier accountability and leadership. The organization's model focuses on <cite id="5">legal litigation, legislative lobbying, and public education</cite> to create systemic change. While it does not provide direct social services like food or shelter, its <cite id="6">program expense ratio of 82.6%</cite> indicates that its entire functional budget is dedicated to its mission-driven advocacy and legal work. This high efficiency is supported by <cite id="7">fundraising costs of only $0.07 per $1 raised</cite>, which is significantly better than many advocacy peers. For donors, the ACLU Foundation offers a stable, century-old platform for <cite id="8">sadaqah-eligible giving</cite> focused on civil liberties in the United States.
